title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway RCE and Web-Shell Activity

steps.title: Send command-bearing request to NetScaler
steps.text: Attacker sends abnormal command-bearing or malformed requests to an unmitigated NetScaler ADC/Gateway.
steps.description: Attacker sends abnormal command-bearing or malformed requests to an unmitigated NetScaler ADC/Gateway.

steps.title: Unauthenticated command execution
steps.text: CVE-2026-88771/88772 yield unauthenticated command execution / memory-overflow exploitation.
steps.description: CVE-2026-88771/88772 yield unauthenticated command execution / memory-overflow exploitation.

steps.title: Deploy PHP web shell (WHIPSHOT)
steps.text: Attacker writes a PHP web shell into appliance web-serving locations for persistent access.
steps.description: Attacker writes a PHP web shell into appliance web-serving locations for persistent access.

steps.title: Deploy SLAPSHOT Python tunneler
steps.text: Attacker transfers and runs the SLAPSHOT Python tunneler for reconnaissance and tunneling.
steps.description: Attacker transfers and runs the SLAPSHOT Python tunneler for reconnaissance and tunneling.

steps.title: File and directory discovery
steps.text: Reconnaissance examines appliance data and configuration.
steps.description: Reconnaissance examines appliance data and configuration.

steps.title: Exfiltrate over established channel
steps.text: Files are removed through the established C2/tunnel channel.
steps.description: Files are removed through the established C2/tunnel channel.

steps.title: Detect web-service child process and new PHP
steps.text: Blue team flags appliance web-service processes spawning a shell/Python interpreter and new PHP content in web roots.
steps.description: Blue team flags appliance web-service processes spawning a shell/Python interpreter and new PHP content in web roots.

steps.title: Rebuild and rotate secrets
steps.text: SOC upgrades to fixed releases, rebuilds compromised appliances, revokes sessions and rotates appliance-held secrets.
steps.description: SOC upgrades to fixed releases, rebuilds compromised appliances, revokes sessions and rotates appliance-held secrets.
